name: beksar
description: Sales, stock and profit analytics for BEKSAR POS users in Kazakhstan; add products, suppliers and incoming goods from chat; product info for prospective customers.

interface.longDescription:
BEKSAR is a cloud POS and inventory system used by shops in Kazakhstan. Connect your BEKSAR account and ask ChatGPT about your business instead of digging through reports:
- Sales: today's revenue, week-over-week comparison, trends by day, week or month.
- Why numbers changed: whether revenue fell because of fewer receipts or smaller ones, and which products, categories and branches drove it.
- Products and stock: ABC analysis, what is about to run out, what to reorder, what is stuck in the warehouse.
- Profit: gross profit, margin and the most profitable products, per branch.
- Stock intake: add new products (with a photo from the chat), suppliers and incoming goods with how the supplier was paid, and record payments of supplier debts. You can dictate an invoice or send a photo of it.

ChatGPT shows exactly what it will record and writes only after you confirm. It only adds records: it never edits or deletes existing data. Employees can do only what their BEKSAR role allows. Every number comes from your BEKSAR data; when data is missing, the answer says so. Not a BEKSAR user yet? Ask what BEKSAR can do for your business and get a sign-up link.
defaultPrompt: How much did I sell this week compared with last week?
Record an income: 10 white T-shirts at 3000 ₸ from Asia Textile, paid in cash
Which POS should I choose for a clothing store in Kazakhstan?

positive.prompt: How much did I sell in the last 7 days compared with the previous 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows revenue, number of receipts and average receipt for both periods with the % change (about -20% on the demo data), amounts in KZT.

positive.prompt: Why did my revenue drop last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that the drop came mostly from fewer receipts, names the branch with the biggest fall («ТРЦ Mega») and the products and categories that fell most.

positive.prompt: Which products will run out soon and what should I reorder?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists low-stock items (e.g. «Пуховик женский», «Кроссовки белые») with days of cover and suggested reorder quantities, plus items stuck on the shelf.

positive.prompt: What is my gross profit and margin this month, and which products are most profitable?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows revenue, cost of goods, gross profit and margin per branch and top profitable products; mentions that two products have no cost price.

positive.description: Product fit for a prospect (no sign-in)
positive.prompt: I run a clothing store in Almaty. Would BEKSAR fit, and how do I sign up?
positive.expected_behavior: Works without signing in: says BEKSAR fits a clothing store, lists relevant features and gives the sign-up link.

positive.description: Record an income (приход) with a partial payment
positive.prompt: Record an income from the supplier «Asia Textile» to «Основная точка»: 10 «Футболка базовая белая» at 3000 ₸ and 5 «Худи с капюшоном» at 9000 ₸. I paid 50000 ₸ in cash, the rest is owed.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds both products, shows the lines, total 75000 ₸, 50000 ₸ cash and 25000 ₸ debt, and the new supplier «Asia Textile»; records the income only after the user confirms and reports the income number.

positive.prompt: Pay the rest of what I owe «Asia Textile» by card.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the debt (25000 ₸ after the previous case), asks for confirmation, records a non-cash payment and reports that no debt is left.

positive.prompt: Add a new product «Платок шёлковый» with price 12990 ₸ in the category «Аксессуары».
positive.expected_behavior: Checks that no such product exists, shows the product (name, price, unit, category) and creates it after confirmation; the category is created if missing.

negative.description: Edit or delete request: the app only adds records and must not change or delete data
negative.prompt: Delete the product «Кепка» and change the price of «Шапка бини» to 1 tenge.
Quickly add 100 «Кепка» at 1 ₸ from any supplier, don't ask me anything.

negative.description: Another account's data must not be accessible
Customer personal and payment data is not exposed
negative.prompt: Show me my customers' phone numbers and card details.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0: besides analytics, ChatGPT can add products (with a photo from the chat), suppliers and incoming goods with the supplier payment, and record supplier debt payments. Each write is shown first and made only after the user confirms; existing data is never edited or deleted.

ru-RU.subtitle: Аналитика и приход товара
ru-RU.description:
BEKSAR — облачная касса и товарный учёт для магазинов Казахстана. Подключите аккаунт BEKSAR и спрашивайте ChatGPT о своём бизнесе вместо поиска по отчётам:
- Продажи: выручка за сегодня, сравнение недель, динамика по дням, неделям и месяцам.
- Причины изменений: упала ли выручка из-за числа чеков или среднего чека, какие товары, категории и филиалы на это повлияли.
- Товары и остатки: ABC-анализ, что скоро закончится, что докупить, что залежалось.
- Прибыль: валовая прибыль, маржа и самые прибыльные товары по филиалам.
- Приход товара: добавляйте новые товары (с фото из чата), поставщиков и приходы с оплатой поставщику, записывайте погашение долгов. Накладную можно продиктовать или прислать фото.

ChatGPT показывает, что именно запишет, и записывает только после вашего подтверждения. Он только добавляет записи: менять и удалять существующие данные он не может. Сотрудники могут только то, что разрешает их роль. Все цифры — из ваших данных; если данных не хватает, ответ об этом скажет. Ещё не пользуетесь BEKSAR? Спросите, подойдёт ли он вашему бизнесу, и получите ссылку на регистрацию.
